A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same work despite the change from U2A to CMPT terminology. Their complete main texts, figures, tables, equations, and appendices support reliable comparison.

before.justification: V1 reports original evaluations on five datasets, missing-modality experiments, token ablations, and feature-estimation analyses.

after.justification: V2 retains original benchmark results and adds dropout-controlled ablations and Food-101 class-level evaluations.

M1.justification: Mask Tokens and token selection become CMPTs and a gating module. The frozen encoders, rank-1 LoRA, cross-modal alignment loss, modality dropout, missing-token substitution, additive fusion, and classifier remain substantively unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate UPMC Food-101, MM-IMDb, Kinetics-Sound, AVE, and CREMA-D on the same tasks and complete/missing-modality conditions. The added analyses remain within this coverage.

E2.justification: The retained benchmark tables preserve their comparator sets. V2 adds explicit no-dropout and dropout-only controls in Figures 4 and 6; its new radar also includes MAP-Input and MAP-Attention at complete MM-IMDb availability, absent from v1's complete-modality comparisons.

E3.justification: Existing splits, encoders, training budgets, and metrics remain unchanged. New ablations train on complete paired data, compare three dropout/token configurations, and sweep image or text availability from 0% to 100% in ten-percentage-point increments.

E4.justification: V2 adds controlled analyses separating modality-dropout and proxy-token benefits on MM-IMDb and Food-101, plus Food-101 class-level token ablations. It removes v1's feature-estimation MSE analysis. The existing modality-dependence analyses survive in supplementary Section S7.

E5.justification: Both versions report means and standard deviations from three independent seeds for the matched- and differing-missing-rate tables. V2 introduces no additional uncertainty-estimation or significance-testing practice.

E6.justification: V2 adds substantial ablation results, including 56.32 versus 44.77 F1-macro for CMPT versus dropout-only with MM-IMDb images entirely missing, and Food-101 class-level results. V1's approximately 0.04 feature-MSE results disappear. All matched benchmark-table scores remain unchanged.

T1.justification: The dataset definitions, alignment objective, token substitution, fusion, and total loss retain the same mathematical substance despite reordered presentation and renamed symbols. Neither version contains theoretical proofs or guarantees.

C1.justification: V2 refocuses the stated contribution on proxy-token robustness and explicitly includes generalization to unseen missing rates and benefits across most classes among its main contributions. The original efficiency and complete/missing-modality performance claims remain largely intact.

C2.justification: V1 claims improvements across all classes despite losses visible in its plots. V2 acknowledges failures such as Short and Documentary and attributes them to insufficient available-modality information. It also removes the strong accurate-reconstruction interpretation based on low MSE; broader modality-dependence limitations remain.

D1.justification: V2 adds a promise to release code and pretrained models on GitHub, without providing an access location. It omits v1's explicit statement that dropout is disabled for already-incomplete training data. Hardware, software, preprocessing, and listed hyperparameters remain unchanged.

R1.justification: V2 removes references including ModDrop, MultiMAE, and several distillation and generative approaches, while focusing its positioning more closely on missing-modality robustness. Much of the broader related work moves to supplementary Section S1. Kim and Kim's publication update represents the same cited work.

P1.justification: The title, terminology, abstract, introduction, and substantial explanatory passages are rewritten. The method gains numbered subsections, missing-modality evaluation precedes complete-modality evaluation, broader related work moves to the supplement, and the discussion is reorganized.

P2.justification: V2 adds a radar summary, redraws and enlarges the method diagram, introduces ablation plots, sorts existing class-level bars by improvement, and removes the MSE figure. Tables are reordered and relabeled, while unchanged modality-dependence plots move into the expanded appendix.

improvement.justification: The added dropout controls strengthen attribution of gains to proxy tokens, and correcting the all-class interpretation makes the conclusions more accurate. These benefits support a limited improvement despite removal of the feature-MSE evidence and an unexplained Food-101 text-only discrepancy: Figure 6a reports 85.31% while Table 2 retains 80.66% under the same stated training/testing setup.
